title: S\'anchez, Feij\'oo, or Abascal? Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X of the Leaders of the Three Main Parties of the 29N General Election in Spain
abstract: arXiv:2611.29765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Source cues are central to political communication, yet reception studies with large language model (LLM) personas as synthetic audiences have not tested whether personas respond to who speaks and not only to what is said. With Spain's general election of 29 November 2026 in mind, we run a speaker-attribution experiment using 1,075 anonymised X posts by the leaders of PSOE, PP and VOX on four topics (the economy and employment, household costs, immigration and corruption) and 791 distinct value-grounded, LLM-generated personas. Each post was assigned to 300 topic-selected persona profiles, 150 grounded in the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and 150 in Moral Foundations Theory, under four conditions: no author, S\'anchez, Feij\'oo or Abascal, yielding 322,470 complete persona-post quartets. Naming any leader lowered support for identical text, with the penalty for Abascal nearly twice as large as those for S\'anchez and Feij\'oo. The penalt

translated_title: 桑切斯、费霍还是阿巴斯卡尔？LLM角色画像阅读西班牙“11·29”大选三大政党领导人X平台帖子时的发言人归因与意识形态一致性
translated_abstract: 来源线索是政治传播的核心要素，然而以大语言模型（LLM）角色画像作为合成受众的接受研究，尚未检验这些画像是否会对“谁在说话”作出反应，而不仅仅是对“说了什么”作出反应。着眼于2026年11月29日的西班牙大选，我们开展了一项发言人归因实验，使用PSOE、PP和VOX三党领导人在四个主题（经济与就业、家庭开支、移民与腐败）上的1,075条匿名化X帖子，以及791个基于价值观的、由LLM生成的独特角色画像。每条帖子被分配给300个按主题筛选的角色画像档案——其中150个基于英格尔哈特-韦尔策尔文化地图，150个基于道德基础理论——在四种条件下进行测试：无作者、桑切斯、费霍或阿巴斯卡尔，共产生322,470组完整的“角色画像-帖子”四元组。研究结果表明，点名任何领导人都降低了对相同文本的支持度，其中阿巴斯卡尔带来的惩罚效应几乎是桑切斯和费霍的两倍。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次通过大规模发言人归因实验验证了LLM角色画像会对发言者身份（而不仅是文本内容本身）作出反应，发现点名西班牙三大政党领导人会系统性降低对相同文本的支持度，且阿巴斯卡尔带来的负面效应约为桑切斯和费霍的两倍。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale speaker-attribution experiment showing that LLM personas respond to who speaks—not only what is said—with naming any of Spain's three main party leaders lowering support for identical text, and the penalty for Abascal being nearly twice as large as those for Sánchez and Feijóo.
